limits: The six tests are deterministic local simulations; they are not external dual-process PostgreSQL plus Redis end-to-end evidence.
L0 zero-command evidence covers projection lookup and allow-path reads; reject-side risk-signal persistence writes remain intentional and are measured separately.
The existing SecurityFixtureCompositionRootIntegrationTests run against local PostgreSQL and Redis, but do not claim dual-node projection end-to-end coverage.
